implementation: Apple corecrypto Module [Apple silicon, User, Software, SL1] (vng_ltc)
description: Cryptographic library offering various cryptographic mechanisms to Apple frameworks in user space. The following cipher implementation is covered: Generic C non-optimized block mode and compound ciphers with ARM VNG AES / hash assembler implementation.
